name: Gignology (Stadium People)
tagline: Event-staffing platform: public job board, applicant pipeline, events and rosters
role: Admin dashboard and job board work by the Softwhere team for Perimeter Software

scenes.title: A job board for event gigs
scenes.body: Candidates search by position, venue or ZIP code and apply online for jobs at each venue.

scenes.title: A dashboard for every role
scenes.body: Venues, events, jobs and tasks at a glance, with menus scoped to Master, Admin, User and Client roles.

scenes.title: Events in list or calendar view
scenes.body: Each event shows positions requested against those rostered, plus request and waitlist counts.

scenes.title: Build each event’s roster
scenes.body: Add workers from the venue’s staffing pool to the roster or waitlist; conflicting events are flagged.

scenes.title: An applicant pipeline to hire
scenes.body: Applicants move from New to ATC, Screened and Pre-Hire, with source tracking and an activity log.
